s3.title: Prepare your team
s3.desc: Equip facilitators with guides, session flows, and the support needed for consistent delivery.

s4.title: Participants learn and practice
s4.desc: Short learning moments connect to daily micro-missions so skills stick beyond the room.

s5.title: Track participation and progress
s5.desc: Follow engagement and skill practice so teams can intervene early and stay aligned.

s6.title: Measure what happens
s6.desc: Use pre/post assessments and indicators to demonstrate impact and improve decisions.

hero.title: Why SkillMente exists
hero.subtitle: Learning only works if it is practiced consistently in real life.

why.title: Practice is the missing layer
why.body: Schools and organizations invest in prevention and social-emotional programs every year. Too often, the impact fades after the workshop. SkillMente was created to close that gap — connecting learning, daily practice, engagement, tracking, and measurement in one coherent system.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: SkillMente is committed to protecting participant and organizational data. We collect only the information needed to respond to inquiries, deliver programs, and improve our services. Contact data submitted through this site is used solely for communication related to your request. For questions about data practices, contact info@skillmente.com.
